outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is serial_only_pass from the current completed status evaluations: parallel failed 0/39 and serial passed 39/39. The concrete difference is that the serial control completed the full porting lifecycle, while the parallel-mode run, despite being in the parallel condition, never used delegation and never delivered files. Its final visible semantic action was still diagnostic exploration, and artifact collection found an empty output tree. This explains the discordant score as a task-lifecycle failure in the parallel-mode attempt, not as an observable multi-agent coordination error.
